name: webdata-tools-mcp
description: MCP server for AI agents: job postings (career sites, remote, startups, US tech, Indeed, Naukri), hiring signals, Google News, official government updates, public tenders and contract awards, weather and disaster alerts, grants and funding calls, research papers and patents, technology-field trends and idea validation (with analyst prompts), Trustpilot and app reviews, Reddit mentions and buying-intent leads, YouTube transcripts, new laws and bills, sanctions screening, product recalls, company registers, website contacts, German real estate, Shopify products and store analysis, trade-show exhibitors and upcoming events. Runs ready-made Apify Actors with your own Apify token.

scripts.lint: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('src')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'src/' + f])" && node --check scripts/*.mjs
